headline: RMC Switchgears informs the exchange of a change or update to its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent
hook: Routine administrative update from RMC Switchgears
summary: Rmc Switchgears Limited has formally notified the stock exchange regarding an update concerning its Registrar and Share Transfer Agent (RTA). Such filings are standard corporate governance disclosures required under listing regulations. For an Indian retail investor, this is a routine administrative filing that does not impact the company's financial performance or operational fundamentals.
why_it_matters: No impact on share price or company operations
